changelog: Fix: Traveling Merchant per-day sections didn't auto-clear on goal completion. 1.7.21 attempted to size them via slot_data.traveling_merchant_locations, but AP doesn't expose that as a slot_data field — the number of TM items per day is computed internally from filler/orphan heuristics (locations.py:extend_filler_locations). Replaced the slot_data read with a generic, slot-data-independent resize in archipelago.lua's onClear: after ALL_LOCATIONS is built from MissingLocations + CheckedLocations, walk LOCATION_MAPPING and for every @-path count how many mapped AP IDs actually exist in this slot, then set ChestCount + AvailableChestCount on that section. This makes the seed's actual location count authoritative and also subsumes the prior backpack-split sizing branch (which now works without needing backpack_size from slot_data).

Fix: goal-completion auto-release left several categories with uncollected sections because either (a) the tracker showed locations that don't exist in the seed, or (b) the AP location IDs the seed actually uses weren't mapped to the tracker section. Fixes: Old Master Cannoli + Pot of Gold get visibility_rules=[secretsanity_on] so they hide when secretsanity is off; Tea Leaves 'Harvested' cropsanity sub-section removed (there's no Harvest Tea Leaves AP location at all); Vault tracker section restructured from 4 fixed amounts to a single 'Bundles' group of 4 — all 28 possible Vault bundle AP IDs (vanilla 27-30 + thematic/remixed 77-100) map to it; Backpack split AP IDs 175-199 (Large + Deluxe 1-12) mapped to the World map sections; Traveling Merchant 901-970 (10 per day × 7 days) all mapped to per-day sections; setting_mapping.lua now reads backpack_size and traveling_merchant_locations from slot_data and sets ChestCount accordingly so the section item count matches the seed.

Fix: Enchanter's Bundle helper was hardcoded for the vanilla 4-of-4 bundle composition (Oak Resin + Wine + Rabbit Foot + Pomegranate), requiring deluxe coop + brew + foraging:3 + fall season all at once. Seeds with bundle_randomization = thematic or remixed have different items and a 3-of-N requirement, making the original rule unsatisfiable. New rule accepts: (1) vanilla 4-of-4 path, OR (2) thematic 3-of-X path via mines floor 41-80 access (Solar Essence + Frozen Tear) + any one of tapper/wine/rabbit-foot, OR (3) floor 81+ access which yields 3 mines minerals directly. Loose proxy since slot_data.modified_bundles isn't parsed yet; covers the common rolled compositions.

Fix: tool upgrade rules. AP's full rule has two pieces: (1) location rule = has_tool(<tool>, <prior_tier>) — received the prior tier of THAT specific tool (rules.py:185-190), AND (2) entrance rule = has(<tier>_bar) & money.can_spend(<upgrade_price>) on the blacksmith_<tier> region (rules.py:435-437). I was using vanilla SDV's mining:N quest-unlock proxy, missing both halves. Per-tool rules now bundle prior-tier-tool + furnace + reach-relevant-mines-floor + money. Iron tier: copper_<tool>,furnacerecipe,can_walk_to_mines_floor_45,can_earn_money_modest. Gold tier: <iron-tier>_<tool>,furnacerecipe,can_walk_to_mines_floor_85,can_earn_money_modest. Iridium tier: gold_<tool>,furnacerecipe,can_mine_iridium,can_earn_money_substantial. World map group rules are OR-of-5-tools at the prior tier, each AND'd with the tier's gate. Matches spoiler sphere placement (Iron Tool Upgrades at sphere 7 because sphere 6 unlocked Iron Bar Logic event).

Fix: helper naming inconsistency. The original pack uses 'has_at_least_iron_pickaxe' for the Pickaxe's 2nd tier but 'has_at_least_steel_<tool>' for every other tool's 2nd tier. My Gold Pickaxe Upgrade rule and Read Alleyway Buffet rule referenced the non-existent 'has_at_least_steel_pickaxe' — undefined Lua call → location stayed unreachable. Added aliases in logic.lua so both naming conventions work: has_at_least_steel_pickaxe → has_at_least_iron_pickaxe, has_at_least_iron_<tool> → has_at_least_steel_<tool> for axe/hoe/can/pan/trash. Gold Pickaxe Upgrade and Alleyway Buffet should now correctly evaluate.

Fix: Read The Alleyway Buffet was gated on the AP item Power: The Alleyway Buffet, same wrong pattern as Animal Catalogue. AP's rule is logic.has(book.name) which resolves through the source registry. The Alleyway Buffet has two sources: a Town trash find that requires iron axe + iron pickaxe, and a 20000g purchase from the rare bookseller. Rule is now $has_at_least_steel_axe,$has_at_least_steel_pickaxe (covers source 1; bookseller_rare path requires Progressive Bookseller Days + Stock: Rare Books tracking which isn't wired up yet — to revisit).

Fix: LOCATION_MAPPING entries are now multi-path. The legacy hand-written entries for tool upgrades (AP ids 717103-717122) and mine elevators map each AP id to the World map's grouped section only. My 1.7.13 generator pass would have added @Tool Upgrades/Copper Hoe Upgrade/ + @Mine Elevators/Floor 5 Elevator/ etc. for the dedicated tabs, but the new entries were skipped because the ids already existed — so a check decremented the World map group but not the per-floor/per-tool leaf on the dedicated tab. archipelago.lua's onLocation and onClear loops now iterate every path in the LOCATION_MAPPING value (instead of only v[1]), and _build/generate_location_mappings.py merges into existing entries instead of skipping. 160 ids upgraded to multi-path — covers all four tiers of Hoe / Pickaxe / Axe / Watering Can / Trash Can on Tool Upgrades, all 24 Mine Elevators, and other category-leaf collisions.

Fix: Rarecrow #7 (Tanuki) and Rarecrow #8 (Tribal Mask) legacy LOCATION_MAPPING paths (@Night Market/Magic Shop Boat/Rarecrow #7) didn't include the parenthetical suffix that's on the tracker section name. PopTracker couldn't resolve the path, so onLocation silently dropped these AP location checks. Paths now match the section names exactly.

Feature: 5 Mastery items (Farming/Mining/Foraging/Fishing/Combat) now tracked as toggle items, AP ids 717481-717485 mapped in item_mapping.lua. 8 mastery_recipe craft locations (Statue of Blessings, Statue of the Dwarf King, Heavy Furnace, Mystic Tree Seed, Treasure Totem, Challenge Bait, Anvil, Mini-Forge) re-gated on the matching mastery item per AP's MasterySource rule, instead of the wrong skill:10 proxy (which never resolved for shuffled-mastery seeds). For seeds with skill_progression = progressive_with_masteries (the typical case), the mastery item is what AP requires; for non-shuffled seeds the rule will be over-strict — revisit if needed.
Superseded by 1.7.18 — never published. Multi-path LOCATION_MAPPING fix bundled into 1.7.18.

Feature: slot-aware entrance reachability. AP's SDV apworld ships randomized_entrances (full {original: replacement} map) in slot_data. New entrance_logic.lua does BFS from Farm using that map + a static entrance graph extracted from AP source (205 regions, 206 entrances, 32 gated). 23 gate helpers cover rusty key, skull key, club card, dark talisman, beach bridge, landslide removed, wizard invitation, CC key, railroad, bus repair, iron axe, goblin quest, 3 obelisks, boat repair, 4 island unlocks, snail cave, island trader, island resort, qi walnut room, volcano bridge. 15 can_reach_<region> helpers exposed for JSON access rules. Reachability cache is lazy-rebuilt on onClear + onItem.

Existing $can_access_<region> helpers (sewer/casino/witch_swamp/desert/island) and $has_skull_key now delegate to the BFS via can_reach() when entrance_logic is loaded, with raw wallet-code fallback for pre-connect.

Rule sweep: Krobus Stardrop → $can_access_sewer,$can_earn_money_modest (was sewerkey,$can_earn_money_late_game — entrance-shuffle-incompatible and wrong money tier). Fishsanity Mutant Carp / Legendary fish: 4 entries swap sewerkey → $can_access_sewer. Monstersanity skull-cavern goals: 7 entries swap skullkey → $has_skull_key. Arcades Junimo Kart: skullkey → $has_skull_key.

Fix: Quest: Advancement gated on $spring (vanilla mailbox unlock proxy). AP gates on getting_started + has(scarecrow), binding constraint being coal (mines floor 41+). Rule now farming:1,$can_walk_to_mines_floor_45. Matches spoiler sphere 5 placement.

Fix: Read Animal Catalogue gated on the AP item Power: Animal Catalogue (poweranimalcatalogue toggle). AP's actual rule is logic.has(book.name) which resolves through the source registry to the vanilla Marnie's Ranch shop (5000g + Year 2), independent of the booksanity AP item. Rule now $can_reach_ranch,$can_earn_money_substantial.

Fix: re-introduce the 1691 LOCATION_MAPPING entries for generated sanity categories (Craftsanity, Eatsanity, Hatsanity, Monstersanity, Walnutsanity, Chefsanity, Moviesanity, Secretsanity, Endgame, Walnut_Purchase, Babies, Buildings, Mine_Elevators, Tool_Upgrades, Friendsanity, Story_Checks) so 'location checked' events auto-mark sections as collected. Root cause of the 1.7.13 regression identified: leaves in the generated categories all have ANONYMOUS sections, and PopTracker requires a trailing '/' on the @Path to address the default section (matches the format of the legacy hand-written Cropsanity/Fishsanity entries: @Cropsanity/Amaranth/Harvested/). Without the trailing slash the resolver did something destructive that hid whole categories. Fixed generator to append the trailing slash and regenerated. Crystal Floor Recipe / Craft Field Snack / Friendsanity hearts / Hatsanity drops / etc. should now auto-mark when the AP location is checked.

Revert: pulled the 1.7.13 LOCATION_MAPPING additions (1691 @TreePath entries for generated sanity categories) — they caused a regression where entire sanity categories disappeared from the tracker view after install. Root cause not fully identified yet; suspect PopTracker's path resolution interacts badly with the generator's @TopLevel/Sub/Leaf walk shape. Side effect: sanity 'location checked' events go back to being silently dropped (Crystal Floor Recipe stays marked uncollected after the AP send) — to revisit. The 1.7.13 rule fixes below are preserved.

Fix: Quest 'Forging Ahead' was gated on mining:6, the vanilla SDV quest unlock requirement. AP gates it on has(Ore.copper) & has(Machine.furnace) instead. Rule is now $can_walk_to_mines_floor_5,furnacerecipe.

Fix: Wedding Ring Recipe was gated on $tmsun OR $tmtues only. In AP it's a shop_recipe at LogicRegion.traveling_cart, reachable from ANY of the 7 day-specific traveling-cart sub-regions. Rule now ORs all 7 days.

Story-quest audit vs Archipelago/.../quest_logic.py — 6 more rules corrected to AP semantics: Advancement $farming1 → $spring; Smelting (none) → $can_walk_to_mines_floor_5,furnacerecipe; Initiation (none) → $can_walk_to_mines_floor_5; A Soldier's Star $can_access_desert/$summer → $summer,$can_earn_money_substantial; Exotic Spirits — added missing $winter on the desert branch.

This release introduced a regression and is superseded by 1.7.14 — the 1691 LOCATION_MAPPING entries broke sanity-category visibility. The quest/recipe rule fixes from this release are retained in 1.7.14.

Fix: $func(arg) syntax isn't supported in PopTracker access rules — only arg-less $func calls work. So $has_at_least_elevator(5) silently failed and Mine Elevator floors 15-30 stayed out-of-logic even when the player had reached e20. Added 23 per-threshold no-arg wrappers (has_at_least_elevator_5, _10, _15, ..., _115) in logic.lua via metaprogramming and updated 25 rules in Mine_Elevators.json + World.json to use them. Same fix that the rest of the pack uses (no parens in $func references).

Fix: $has("X",N) multi-arg access rules never evaluated correctly — PopTracker's rule parser treats top-level commas as AND, so $has("combat",1) was being shredded into two broken halves and the whole rule failed. Locations using these rules (Combat Level 2+, Foraging-gated crafts, all Skill mastery levels, skill-gated craftsanity, tool upgrades, buildings, quests) stayed permanently out-of-logic even after the required items were received. Converted all 154 multi-arg occurrences to PopTracker's built-in shorthand (combat:1, foraging:2, etc.).

Cleanup: also converted single-arg $has("X") (85 occurrences) to bare shorthand X for consistency — same semantics, no Lua hop, matches the convention used in the older hand-written Cooksanity/Fishsanity files.

Fix: Mine Elevator floors 15+ used $has("eN") access rules, but the elevator item is a 24-stage progressive — only the *current* stage's eN code is active, so a player at stage 4 (e20) failed the has("e5") check for Floor 15. Added has_at_least_elevator(min_floor) helper to logic.lua that ORs across all stages from min_floor up, and replaced 22 rules in Mine_Elevators.json. Same fix applied inside can_mine_copper / can_mine_iron / can_mine_gold which had identical bug.

Fix: World.json's grouped Mine Elevators (Floors 25-40 / 45-80 / 85-120) gated only on $can_mine_copper / iron / gold, so they showed in-logic before the matching elevator floor was actually accessible. They now require the lowest-floor's elevator stage on top of the pickaxe tier, matching the dedicated Mine Elevators tab.

Cleanup: Skills_Masteries.json had every Level 2+ row's access_rules key listed 4 times in a row (build-script stutter). Collapsed to one copy each. Strict JSON forbids duplicate keys; even when parsers tolerate it, the duplication was at minimum confusing.

Festival check rules: each festival entry now has the AP per-check requirement on top of the season rule. E.g. Rarecrow #5 (Woman) is now $spring,$can_earn_money_modest (was just $spring). Iridium Fireplace gates on $can_earn_money_late_game (15000g). Lupini Y2/Y3 paintings gated on late-game money. Rules sourced from AP's festival_logic.py festival_rules dict, mapped via _build/patch_festival_check_rules.py.

Fix: setting_mapping.lua's progressive-stage decisions for Museumsanity / Shipsanity / Special Orders compared the slot value against strings, but AP serialises Choice options as INTEGER enum values (option_randomized = 2, etc.). Comparisons now match both int and string values, so museum_donation / shipsanity_<mode> / board_on stages activate correctly. Museum tab should now populate.

Fix: World.json's Floor 10 / Floor 20 entries (legacy section, separate from the duplicate in Story_Checks) had no access_rules, so they showed as in-logic regardless of whether the player had a pickaxe. Added $can_walk_to_mines_floor_5 to gate them properly.

Fix: Feast of the Winter Star festival entries (Secret Santa, The Legend of the Winter Star, etc.) had no season rule because the patcher's region map missed 'Feast of the Winter Star'. They now correctly require $winter.

Fix: re-added the bshuffle/tshuffle/eshuffleon/pshuffle/ashuffle/ashuffle2 toggle items in items/settings.json that were accidentally reverted during a regeneration. Without these toggles, has("bshuffle") was always false → Buildings/Mine Elevators/Tool Upgrades visibility filter rejected every entry → empty tabs.
Fix: Story_Checks visibility_rules emitted ['717201', null] arrays from a generator path that didn't handle the no-flag case. Now emits a clean ['717201'] when there's no flag to gate on.
Pipeline cleanup: build_flat in generate_locations.py now uses the same single comma-AND visibility format as the grouped path so multi-mode redistribution and AND collapse stay consistent.
Help Wanted! locations now appear: setting_mapping.lua reads quest_locations from slot data and sets the consumable count accordingly so $quests1..N helpers fire.

Fishsanity / Cooksanity / Cropsanity / Shipsanity / Museumsanity / Special Orders settings are now driven via the existing progressive items' stages (set_active alone never advanced the stage past 1, so the stage-2+ codes like fishsanity_on / shipsanity_fish / museum_donation never lit up). Locations in those tabs should reappear properly.

Buildings / Mine Elevators / Tool Upgrades / Arcade tabs were empty because their visibility flags (bshuffle/tshuffle/eshuffleon/pshuffle/ashuffle/ashuffle2) had no toggle items in items/settings.json. Added them.

Town/Fishing/Night Market/Desert Festival entries now have correct season access_rules ($spring/$summer/$fall/$winter) sourced from AP locations.csv region. 83 entries gated. The Town Festivals showing-as-reachable bug is fixed.

Pepper Rex no longer sits alone under Goals: per-monster locations now win the dedup over goal-tagged locations, so Pepper Rex (which has both tags) goes to the Per Monster section like every other monster.

Layout restructure: Walnut Purchase moved back under Walnuts (Walnutsanity + Walnut Purchase as sub-tabs). Endgame moved into Progression (Buildings/Mine Elevators/Tool Upgrades/Endgame). The Endgame Goals top-level tab is gone.

Multi-mode visibility_rules (e.g. shipsanity having Fish/Full/Everything alternatives) are no longer collapsed into AND-of-all by fix_visibility_rules_and.py — the patcher now respects pre-distributed OR alternatives.

Regenerated map background PNGs after the 1.7.5 restructure. Eatsanity_map.png dropped its Cooking section (now 820x1528, was 820x2180) since those entries moved to the Cooksanity Eaten column. Other map sizes unchanged.

FIXED 1.7.4 overcorrection: visibility_rules with multi-mode flags (e.g., shipsanity_fish + shipsanity_full + shipsanity_all) were collapsed into a single AND, requiring all modes simultaneously — impossible since modes are mutually exclusive, so locations never showed. Now redistributed as `[code,fish, code,full, code,all]` = code AND (fish OR full OR all). 288 multi-mode rules fixed across Cropsanity, Fishsanity, Boards, Museum_Donations.
Moved Rat Problem Cutscene marker on the main map from (530, 285) to (720, 290) so it no longer overlaps the Introductions / How to Win Friends quest markers.

Restructured the Sanities menu: only actual sanity options now live there. New top-level 'Progression' tab contains Buildings, Mine Elevators, Tool Upgrades. New 'Endgame Goals' tab contains Endgame and Walnut Purchase. Babies became a sub-tab of Friends inside Sanities (friendship-adjacent). Walnut Purchase moved out of Walnuts since it's not a sanity.

CRITICAL FIX: visibility_rules were OR'd by PopTracker when written as multi-element arrays — meaning locations showed up whenever the global sanity flag was set, even if the specific id wasn't in the seed. All ~1100 visibility_rules across both generated and legacy JSONs converted to single comma-separated strings (AND semantics). This is what made Monstersanity Goals/Progressive Goals and mod-only Craftsanity entries appear unconditionally.
Merged Chefsanity into Cooksanity: each recipe row now has a Recipe column alongside Cooked and Shipped (158 children added across 162 recipes). Chefsanity tab removed.
Merged Eatsanity Cooking into Cooksanity: each recipe row now has an Eaten column. Cooking sub-section removed from Eatsanity tab.

Moved 4 missing mandatory story checks onto the main Stardew Valley map: Krobus Stardrop, Demetrius's Breakthrough, Volcano Caldera Treasure, Rat Problem Cutscene. Story Checks tab removed (Mines Floor X Treasure entries were already wired to the existing Mines section).

- Monstersanity: all 28 per-monster locations gate on the right region (mines floor, skull cavern, island, slime hutch, quarry, mutant bug lair) via _build/extract_monster_rules.py

- Museum donations: 91 of 95 artifacts/minerals gate on their source (artifact spot = hoe, geode-only = pickaxe, skull-cavern-only = skullkey, island-only = island access) via _build/extract_museum_rules.py

New logic.lua helpers: has_at_least_<tier>_<tool>, has_weapon, can_walk_to_mines_floor_5/45/85, can_earn_money_modest/substantial/late_game
Fixed cumulative tool-tier bug in can_mine_copper/iron/gold (previously only checked stage 1, now matches at any higher tier)

Added 4 previously-missing categories: Buildings (19), Mine Elevators (24, individual floors), Tool Upgrades (28, individual tiers), Story Checks (16, incl. Krobus Stardrop, Demetrius's Breakthrough, Mines Floor X Treasure)

Added Quest: Forging Ahead (mining 6), Monster: Dust Sprite (can_mine_iron), Museum: Ancient Doll/Sword (need hoe), Rarecrow #5 / Woman (spring), Wedding Ring Recipe (traveling cart day)
